snippet.title: Dune: Awakening — Chapter 3 Free Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Chapter 3 is now available! This free update brings more story, revamped endgame progression, specialization to your character, new locations, new repeatable Testing Stations and much more.

Read our full blog where we dive into all the new features: https://bit.ly/Chapter3OutNow

Dune: Awakening is out now on Steam: https://bit.ly/DuneAwakeningSteam

Dune: Awakening is an Open World Survival RPG where you can fully immerse yourself in the epic world of Dune. Alone or with friends, explore a vast open world Arrakis, survive the sandworms, build a home, craft an ornithopter, and unravel the mystery of the missing Fremen.
